3490-7075-7730-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-7075-7730-7763.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-4574-6972.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
3899-4574-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Arcbound Reclaimer.
When Arcbound Reclaimer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Reclaimer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Reclaimer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an artifact card in your graveyard.
If needed, hold priority and repeat step 1 until Arcbound Reclaimer dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When Arcbound Reclaimer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature that has power 2 or greater

101-1987-7907.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
101-1987-7907.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-1987-7907.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

826-3899-6243-7895.notablePrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-3899-6243-7895.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, removing all creature types from Little Bear.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Little Bear.
When Little Bear dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Little Bear from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel with flying and a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Little Bear enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Amoeboid Changeling.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-7329-7824.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is 2 or greater.
539-3899-4552-7329-7824.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-3699-4885.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a creature token.
3259-3699-4885.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Cadira, triggering Breath of Fury and Cadira.
Resolve the Cadira trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

997-1580-2301-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-3490-4268-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-4268-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

4268-5641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4268-5641-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

891-1258-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Abduction triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

3670-4508-7223.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
3670-4508-7223.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ingenious Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Ingenious Artillerist is a Pirate due to Stalactite Dagger, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Ingenious Artillerist triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Ingenious Artillerist trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

1725-3741.description:
At the beginning of each draw step, Omen Machine prevents the active player from drawing a card, and causes them to exile the top card of their library, and cast that card if its a spell without paying its mana cost, or put it onto the battlefield if it's a land.
If an opponent casts a spell this way, Void Mirror triggers, countering that spell.

1020-2866-3497-4050.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
1020-2866-3497-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding one mana of any color.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Ezzaroot Channeler.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding one mana of any color.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Ezzaroot Channeler.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

1640-3011-4522.easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
1640-3011-4522.notablePrerequisites: Quest for Pure Flame has at least four quest counters on it.
1640-3011-4522.description:
Activate Quest for Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and sacrificing it.
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to half their life total, rounded down, times 2, and dealing no damage to you due to Pariah's Shield.
1640-3011-4522.notes: If the opponents have an odd life total, they will have 1 life remaining. If they have an even life total, they will have 0 life and lose the game.

1323-1376-4687.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
1323-1376-4687.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Priest of Titania's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

771-1980-5990-6229-6668.notablePrerequisites:
Tetsuo has an Equipment attached to it with mana value 5 or greater.
Tetsuo does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Relearn or Sorceress's Schemes must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
771-1980-5990-6229-6668.description:
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Savage Beating without paying its mana cost, choosing its second mode.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Savage Beating.
Resolve both Savage Beatings, causing you to get two additional combat phases after this one.
Move to your first combat phase.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Relearn without paying its mana cost, targeting Sorceress's Schemes.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Relearn, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Relearns, causing you to return Sorceress's Schemes and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase.
Repeat steps 1 through 4 one additional time.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Sorceress's Schemes without paying its mana cost, targeting Relearn.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Sorceress's Schemes, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Sorceress's Schemess, causing you to return Relearn and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase, and repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

3609-6459.description:
Activate Aetheric Amplifier by paying {4} and tapping it, doubling the charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

222-527-2079-2511.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2079-2511.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

372-2556-3603.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Cloudshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Mnemonic Wall exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
372-2556-3603.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Mnemonic Wall and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Mnemonic Wall trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Mnemonic Wall and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

560-3199-3209.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
You control at least two untapped creatures, one of which must be green.
560-3199-3209.description:
Activate Spellbinding Soprano's encore ability by paying {3}{R} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Declare each Spellbinding Soprano token as an attacker.
Each Spellbinding Soprano token triggers, causing instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn to cost {1} less to cast for each Spellbinding Soprano token.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by tapping a green creature and any other creature you control, creating a 1/1 Soldier and a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Repeat step 4.

837-2440-3263-3544.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other Humans and/or Wizards.
837-2440-3263-3544.description:
Activate Seal of Removal by sacrificing it, returning Auramancer to your hand.
Cast Auramancer by paying {3}.
When Auramancer enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Auramancer trigger, returning Seal of Removal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {4}.
Cast Seal of Removal by paying {1}.
Repeat.
If you control five or more Humans and/or Wizards, this combo nets infinite mana.

1744-2676.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Scourge of Valkas.
The five Scourge of Valkas tokens enter the battlefield, triggering each Scourge of Valkas five times.
Resolve all Scourge of Valkas triggers, dealing at least 180 damage divided among a maximum of 30 targets.

2050-3525-5227.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Sprawl attached to a Forest you control.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Arbor Elf.
2050-3525-5227.notablePrerequisites:
Arbor Elf does not have summoning sickness.
"Blue" chosen with Utopia Sprawl.
2050-3525-5227.description:
Activate the Forest Utopia Sprawl is attached to by tapping it, adding {G} or any color it can produce.
Utopia Sprawl's last ability triggers, adding {U}
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the Forest.
Activate the Aura by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.
